text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer-san.
That Umamusume over there...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through town with Kiseki,
we spotted an Umamusume looking around anxiously.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Um, is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Foreign Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Uh... Me, Japan, sightseeing.
Friends, together, came.
But, friends, no here... They gone.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Eh, ah, you're from overseas...!
You're here for sightseeing and got separated from your group?
Oh no, we have to find them right away!

text_block_list.name: Foreign Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Hum? But... so, sorry.
Don't, know, where they are..."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No problem at all!
Besides, isn't it a wonderful coincidence?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A meeting in a foreign land when you're in distress!
Doesn't it feel like the start of something exciting?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: So you got separated around here, right?

text_block_list.name: Foreign Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I was looking... at the scenery... the sea...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, can't be helped!
It really is gorgeous here.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, did you get to eat the gelato?
It's really famous here!
You didn't miss out 'cause you got lost and panicked, did you~?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Not around here either, huh.
Hmm, they're really not easy to find..."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...No, not yet, not yet!!
Let's check more places where tourists might go!
It'll be fine!

text_block_list.name: Foreign Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ……！　Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huuuhm, not here, huh...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Even the police said they had no matching information...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Still, it's too early to give up!
I just came up with a special plan!
Let's head to the outdoor stairs, both of you!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, maybe here is fine~?
Foot traffic outside... alright! Perfect!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's a full-on "two-page spread"! Bam!
In other words—we're gonna steal everyone's attention right now!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: *inhale*...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Companiooon!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Is anyone theeeere?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Heeeey!!

text_block_list.name: Passersby
text_block_list.text:
“—What's that? Are they saying something?
—Are they lost?”

text_block_list.name: Passersby
text_block_list.text:
“—Kinda neat. Imma upload a video.
—Waving a smartphone? Haha, waving back.”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, she's waving her phone back at me!?
I have a good feeling about this plan...!!
choice_data_list: You really gave me a fright...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh...
Shouting "Bam!" and stirring people's hearts—
doesn't that make me feel just like a main character!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Look, everyone's stopped to watch!
They're looking over, paying attention...
Let's borrow their strength!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Actually, she's loooost!!
Is anyone with this kid?! Anyooooone?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if answering Kiseki's voice,
tiny lights flickered upon the ground below.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Their numbers grew, drawing in those around them,
as if creating a massive vortex—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look at this!
It's going viral on social media!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, just as planned!
If word keeps spreading like this,
someone's bound to find this little one's friends...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...! Right?
It's such a... dreamlike sight!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
*ahem* Welcome, Trainer.
Step just outside everyday life and into a thrilling, manga-like world!
choice_data_list: ...You sure live in a wonderful world, Kiseki!
...You sure live in a wonderful world, Kiseki!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Flutter flutter flutter...)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hm? ...Huh?! A helicopter?!
Wait, isn't it heading straight for us?!

text_block_list.name: Foreign Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look, friends!!
Friends are on it!!
They came to pick me up!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Eeeh~~~~?!

text_block_list.name: Brawny Suited Man
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for rescuing Milady.
Thanks to the information spread on social media and a glowing spot on the ground, we were able to locate her safely.

text_block_list.name: Foreign Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki! Thank you.
Party as a thank-you! Please enjoy.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Awawa... Who would've thought she was an ultra-mega-super celebrity visiting Japan incognito...!
choice_data_list: This is just like something out of a manga...!
I guess things like this really can happen...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: T-That's true... !?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Trainer and I,
the two of us have become the main characters!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
There is one!
Jumping right out of everyday life into the world of manga!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
See, getting excited over the possibility
of it existing... isn't so bad, right?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hah! Pull yourself together!
We're here, so we ought to enjoy it to the fullest!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Let's enjoy it!
Together with me! This manga-like world!
